official_definition: (Once per Turn: Same Name) By sending a core from any of your Purple Grandwalker Nexus to your Field, activate the (When Summoned) effect of a "Nether" Ultimate you control.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Corpse Unleash] or [Corpse Unleash: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Corpse Unleash]", "give [Corpse Unleash]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
